Local metres around each anchor: +x east, +z south. buildings/parts/roads are the PRODUCTION app data (sgdata/sg_bld.bin, sg_roads.bin) = what the app draws and hides; h = the app height (OSM height / levels, else ESTIMATED: est true) and often wrong for towers: use meta.h / your research. osm / name / floors / osm_h come from the OSM API footprint overlapping the app footprint best (IoU >= 0.5; osm "-" = no match). parts = the app part records of one building (base / top / ring). roads[].br = bridge (kept whole, elev = the app deck height per vertex, m). areas = OSM land-use polygons with a node in the box, clipped to it. pois = named OSM nodes.
